heading: Today
text: Patchy fog early, then mostly to partly sunny. Highs from the mid 50s to lower 60s north, upper 50s to mid 60s in the south. Northwest winds around 5 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear to start, then increasing high clouds after midnight. Lows mainly from the mid 30s to lower 40s, with mid to upper 40s in the broad valley west, and mid 20s to lower 30s northeast and in the Adirondacks. Winds light and variable from the Green Mountains eastward, becoming south near 10 mph in areas west of the Greens.

heading: Sunday
text: Sun filtering through increasing high clouds. A rising chance of late-day showers south from the Hudson Valley into Bennington County and the Berkshires, chance farther east near the Massachusetts border. Highs in the low to mid 60s south, mid to upper 60s north. Winds becoming south 5 to 10 mph, and gusting to 25 mph from the Green Mountains westward.
